name: SFA Engineering Corporation
summary: SFA Engineering Corporation manufactures and sells display equipment, logistics systems, secondary battery, semiconductor equipment, material handling, and special business equipment in South Korea and internationally. The company offers smart factory, that includes NEO AI solution and NEO platform solution; semiconductor equipment, such as clean logistics system and test equipment, as well as N2 stocker, OHT, AGV, inter-layer high-speed lifter, clean module conveyor, and application test; and module equipment; and front-end equipment.
